note: M3 = (ii') inputs: ENDF/B-VIII.0 incident-neutron evaluations, MF4/MT2. Acquisition ids and file_sha256 are filled when the acquisitions exist (empty = unpinned; the build refuses unless allowed). Catalogue MAT numbers VERIFIED against the NNDC list https://www.nndc.bnl.gov/endf-b8.0/lists/neutrons.list: C-12 = MAT 625 (LANL/ORNL EVAL-AUG15 Hale, Young, Fu), O-16 = MAT 825 (LANL EVAL-DEC16 Hale, Paris, Young, Chadwick). The upper energy limit of the MF4 evaluations (20 vs 150 MeV) is UNVERIFIED: no open source confirms it. The files could not be acquired (size cap); M3 is construction impossible under the plan, this code and its synthetic tests are the record of the attempt.
